alt: Rolling green hills at sunrise, with mist in the valleys and dew on the grass.
prompt:
Use: an example landscape photograph for a component library's Carousel, Image and Card stories, shown up to 720×405 (16:9) and also cropped to 3:2, square and 4:5, so the subject must survive a centre crop.
Subject: rolling green hills in early morning, before anyone is up.
Details: low mist in the valleys between the hills, a pale blue sky, the sun just above the hills on the right, dew on the grass in the foreground, a few scattered trees on the ridges.
Composition: wide 16:9 landscape, eye level, horizon at about two thirds height, the main subject in the centre third, uncluttered foreground.
Style: natural landscape photograph, real lens and depth, gentle natural colour grading, soft clean light, crisp detail without oversharpening, calm and uncluttered, no people.
Constraints: no text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border, no buildings with signs, no people, no animals in close-up.
